jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
We're hiring on behalf of a Haystack partner!

The Role
• Develop custom software solutions within an Agile development framework.
• Configure, analyze, and maintain program code to support business functions and minimize technical debt.
• Design efficient database structures, potentially translating logical models to physical designs.
• Ensure seamless integration between various applications and critical systems.
• Troubleshoot and resolve production issues with a focus on thorough resolution.
• Document key work and maintain a strong understanding of assigned applications and projects.

What You'll Need
• Bachelor's degree in a related discipline or equivalent experience.
• 2+ years of professional experience in software development.
• Demonstrable experience with Java, J2EE, Spring Framework, Hibernate, HTML5, and Web Services.
• Proficiency in JavaScript and web development technologies.
• Intermediate SQL skills and experience with relational databases.
• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and troubleshooting abilities.

What's On Offer
• Competitive annual salary ($89,400 - $134,000) plus potential for flexible paid time off.
• Comprehensive benefits including paid holidays, wellness days, and various leave options.
• Opportunities for professional development and to work with cutting-edge technologies.
• A dynamic environment where collaboration and continuous learning are highly valued.

Apply via Haystack today!

jobs.title: Software Engineer Skill Level 3 [D.26.0210]
jobs.description:
Applicants must already hold a TS/SCI clearance with a current Full Scope Polygraph before applying
. We are not sponsoring or processing clearances for this position
. Candidates who are seeking to obtain a clearance do not meet the minimum requirements.

Salary Range: $211k-$231k per year with an additional $53k-$58k in immediately vested company 401(k) contributions

Position Requirements:
The Software Engineer develops, maintains, and enhances complex and diverse software systems (e.g., processing-intensive analytics, novel algorithm development, manipulation of extremely large data sets, real-time systems, and business management information systems) based upon documented requirements. Works individually or as part of a team. Reviews and tests software components for adherence to the design requirements and documents test result. Resolves software problem reports. Utilizes software development and software design methodologies appropriate to the development environment. Provides specific input to the software components of system design to include hardware/software trade¬ offs, software reuse, use of Commercial Off-the-shelf (COTS)/Government Off-the-shelf (GOTS) in place of new development, and requirements analysis and synthesis from system level to individual software components.

Position Responsibilities

Analyze user requirements to derive software design and performance requirements
Debug existing software and correct defects
Provide recommendations for improving documentation and software development process standard
Design and code new software or modify existing software to add new features
Integrate existing software into new or modified system or operating environment
Develop simple data queries for existing or proposed databases or data repositories
Write or review software and system documentation
Serve as team lead at the level appropriate to the software development process being used on any particular project
Design or implement complex database or data repository interfaces/queries
Develop or implement algorithms to meet or exceed system performance and functional standards
Assist with developing and executing test procedures for software component
Develop software solutions by analyzing system performance standards, confer with users or system engineers; analyze systems flow, data usage and work processes; and investigate problem areas
Modify existing software to correct errors, to adapt to new hardware, or to improve its performance
Design, develop and modify software systems, using scientific analysis and mathematical models to predict and measure outcome and consequences of design
Design or implement complex algorithms requiring adherence to strict timing, system resource, or interface constraints; Perform quality control on team products
Implement recommendations for improving documentation and software development process standards
Oversee one or more software development teams and ensure the work is completed in accordance with the constraint of the software development process being used on any particular project
Confer with system engineers and hardware engineers to derive software requirements and to obtain info1mation on project limitations and capabilities, performance requirements and interfaces
Coordinate software system installation and monitor equipment functioning to ensure operational specifications are met
Recommend new technologies and processes for complex software projects
Serve as the technical lead of multiple software development teams
Select the software development process in coordination with the customer and system engineering
Ensure quality control of all developed and modified software
Delegate programming and testing responsibilities to one or more team and monitor their performance

Basic Qualifications:
Twenty (20) years’ experience as a SWE in programs and contracts of similar scope, type, and complexity is required. Bachelor’ s degree in Computer Science or related discipline from an accredited college or university is required. Four (4) years of additional SWE experience on projects with similar software processes may be substituted for a bachelor’s degree.

Preferred Qualifications

jobs.title: Infrastructure Software Engineer: Application Engineering (66385DB)
jobs.description:
Referment is working with a global investment and technology organisation to hire a lead-level Infrastructure Software Engineer for an application engineering team. You’ll build resilient internal platforms and services that improve software delivery and developer effectiveness across a technically demanding organisation.

The role combines hands-on distributed-systems engineering with technical architecture, product thinking and close collaboration. You’ll translate the needs of developers and infrastructure specialists into services that are reliable, usable and able to operate at significant scale.

The Role

Own infrastructure products and services that improve developer productivity.
Lead large technical projects from initial problem definition through design, delivery and operation.
Act as a senior technical architect for the wider application engineering team.
Partner with developers, application engineers and infrastructure specialists to understand user needs.
Shape product direction while making detailed engineering decisions and building production solutions.

What We're Looking For

At least seven years of direct experience designing, building and scaling large distributed systems.
Hands-on experience building within the Kubernetes ecosystem.
A track record of delivering complex developer-facing or user-facing products.
Strong programming across one or more relevant languages such as Python, Go or Rust.
A computer science or related technical degree.
Excellent communication, self-management and stakeholder skills, with a service-oriented approach.

Desirable Experience

Linux and networking fundamentals.
Hands-on work with on-premises infrastructure.

This could suit a senior or staff software engineer, platform engineer or developer-infrastructure specialist who wants architectural responsibility without leaving hands-on delivery.

jobs.title: Senior Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
Description

Job Title:
Senior Systems Engineer

Department:
Engineering

Location Options:
Kennesaw, GA; California, MD; Jacksonville, FL; Remote

Reports To:
Chief System Engineer

Company Overview

Magee Technologies (MTech) is a leading provider of comprehensive aerostructure design, analysis, and solutions. Headquartered in Southern Maryland, the company leverages decades of experience and cutting-edge technologies to deliver innovative engineering services to a global client base. MTech's team of highly skilled professionals specializes in areas ranging from structural design and stress analysis to tooling and manufacturing support. With a relentless focus on quality, Magee Technologies has established itself as a trusted partner for aerospace companies seeking to enhance their capabilities and drive innovation.

MTech Offers

A competitive compensation package
Flexible work schedule
Paid Time Off including Holidays, PTO, Military Pay, Bereavement, and Jury Duty
Immediate 401 (k) eligibility, with up to 4% company match
Full Healthcare Eligibility including subsidized Medical, Dental, and Vision
Flexible Spending Account and Dependent Care Flexible Spending Account
Health Savings Account
Employee Referral Bonus
Company Provided Short- and Long-Term Disability insurance
Company Provided Life Insurance
Critical Illness, Accident and Voluntary Life Insurance Eligibility
Fantastic company culture and atmosphere

Impact Summary

The Senior Systems Engineer provides senior-level systems engineering support for U.S. military aircraft platforms, with emphasis on development, integration, test, verification, and sustainment of aircraft hardware and related systems. This role translates customer and program requirements into executable technical requirements, supports sound engineering decisions, and works closely with program management, Government program offices, subcontractors, and cross-functional engineering teams to ensure technical accuracy, system performance, airworthiness alignment, cybersecurity awareness, and compliance with Navy program expectations.

Responsibilities

Collaborate with Government stakeholders to ensure compliance with military standards, airworthiness requirements, cybersecurity directives, and program goals.
Lead systems engineering activities across the full lifecycle, including requirements management, test planning, verification/validation and production readiness.
Define, analyze, and manage system-level requirements for aircraft subsystems.
Develop system architectures, interface control documents and technical baseline definitions.
Oversee system qualification including laboratory testing, ground testing, and flight test support.
Conduct trade studies, risk assessments, and technical evaluations to support decision-making.
Support configuration management throughout development and sustainment phases.
Develop presentations and represent the engineering team in technical reviews.

Competencies

Systems Thinking: Ability to understand complex systems, dependencies, interfaces, technical relationships, and mission objectives and apply that understanding to system-level engineering decisions.
Customer Focus: Ability to understand customer and program needs and translate them into executable technical requirements and practical engineering solutions.
Problem Solving: Ability to investigate ambiguous, complex, or technically challenging problems, evaluate alternatives, and develop practical, defensible solutions.
Communication: Ability to communicate complex technical information clearly and effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences through written documentation, presentations, and verbal communication.
Technical Risk Management: Ability to identify, assess, communicate, and mitigate technical risks; evaluate potential impacts to system performance, schedule, cost, and mission objectives; and drive risks toward resolution.
Collaboration: Ability to build effective working relationships across engineering disciplines, Government organizations, program management, subcontractors, and other stakeholders.

Requirements

Qualifications
:

Bachelor’s degree in Systems Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related technical field; master’s degree preferred.
Minimum of five years of recent systems engineering experience supporting military aircraft, aerospace systems, or other complex technical systems.
Experience leading or supporting systems engineering activities across requirements management, architecture development, integration, verification, validation, and sustainment.
Ability to develop, manage, and maintain system-level requirements, requirements traceability, interface documentation, and technical baseline materials.
Experience supporting test planning, system qualification, laboratory testing, ground testing, flight test activities, data review, and deficiency resolution.
Working knowledge of military standards, airworthiness requirements, cybersecurity considerations, and configuration management practices applicable to aircraft systems.
Ability to conduct trade studies, risk assessments, technical evaluations, and alternatives analyses to support engineering and program decisions.
Strong technical writing, presentation, and communication skills, with the ability to brief technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Experience working with Government program offices, subcontractors, program management, and cross-functional engineering teams; NAVAIR or Navy PMA experience preferred.
Must be a US Citizen with the ability to obtain and maintain a US Security clearance.

EEO Statement

MTech is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate employees and applicants on the basis of sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religious creed, national origin, physical or mental disability, protected veteran status or any other characteristic protected by law with regard to any employment practices provided the individual is qualified, with or without reasonable accommodations, to perform the essential functions of the job. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.
